display_name: DURA 源物理残差加权训练
description: 归一化 DURA 全局修正及源物理残差加权，仅训练期使用阈值。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 physical GPU7, FP32 TF32 off deterministic source training; CPU ground

data.version: fixed source training cache epochs21/22/23; source diagnostic epoch19
data.representation: Paired source received/clean and frozen DURA output/physical variance
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 32768 source fit IDs randomly sampled without replacement after excluding RX4/6/8 day3 and the 672 fixed source pilot IDs

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: 672 fixed previously explored source L_s/U_s IQ, not independent of DURA

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen DURA v1.0 plus independently initialized 14793858-parameter zero-output global/local correction
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Fixed original DURA source provenance and exact source context fit IDs; no F/TX/V/target in training
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original frozen DURA and matching legal source IQ context; no prior candidate checkpoint
checkpoint.selection_rule: Final epoch 20 fixed, no source pilot or target based selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU7: one this-run GPU worker; >=4096 MiB free and fewer than three total compute apps; preserve other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner only for source contract/role mismatch, nonfinite computation, incorrect checkpoint, target leakage or unrecoverable technical failure. Preserve all artifacts.

rows.method: Normalized large-context DURA with source innovation risk
rows.purpose: Emphasize source waveform errors where observable physical innovation is high
rows.seed_notes: Model 2026110612; source fit 2026110611; order 2026110613; fixed evaluation 2026092701.
rows.budget_ref: 14793858 trainable plus 266951 frozen DURA parameters; 32768 IDs x three views x 20 epochs, batch32

notes: Fresh zero-output correction from fixed DURA; no candidate weights, F, TX labels, V or target in training.
DURA guard plus 0.5 mean normalized source IQ error over examples with innovation energy / DURA output energy >= 0.00937667116522789; zero if no example qualifies.
Threshold is the source-only 75th percentile from seed 2026110803 and 4096 source IDs x three views, independently of target; threshold and selection are training-only.
32768 legal source IDs x three views, AdamW .0003, batch32, fixed 20 epochs; record selected fraction per epoch.
Thirteen focused tests, actual DURA/source IQ six-step GPU smoke and independent P0/P1 review passed.
Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL on seven Phase1 ground views, all predictions before independent truth-last, no target feedback.
